41859-the-terms-of-surrender.title: Surrender
41859-the-terms-of-surrender.creator: Louis Tracy
41859-the-terms-of-surrender.description: A book by Louis Tracy. Then John Darien Power swung out again into the vivid sunshine of Colorado ("vivid" is the correct adjective for sunshine thereabouts in June about the hour of the siesta) and gently encouraged a dispirited mustang to hobble on three legs into the iron-roofed lean-to which served as a stable at "MacGonigal's." Meanwhile, the proprietor of the store gazed after Power's retreating figure until neither man nor horse was visible.

arxiv-2112-04370.title: Band-like structures and quartets in deformed N = Z N=Z nuclei
arxiv-2112-04370.creator: M. Sambataro a and N. Sandulescu b
arxiv-2112-04370.description: Abstract We provide a description of deformed N = Z N=Z nuclei in a formalism of α \alpha -like quartets. Quartets are constructed variationally by resorting to the use of proper intrinsic states. Various types of intrinsic states are introduced which generate different sets of quartets for a given nucleus.

arxiv-2206-00653.title: Novel features of attractors and transseries in non-conformal Bjorken flows
arxiv-2206-00653.creator: Syo Kamata, Jakub Jankowski, Mauricio Martinez
arxiv-2206-00653.description: Abstract In this work we investigate the impact of conformal symmetry breaking on hydrodynamization of a far-from-equilibrium fluid. We find a new kind of transseries solutions for the non-conformal hydrodynamic equations of a longitudinal boost invariant expanding plasma. The new transseries solutions unveil a rich physical structure which arises due to the interplay of different physical scales.

arxiv-2308-10237.title: Synchronization via impulsive deadbeat coupling
arxiv-2308-10237.creator: S. Emre Tuna
arxiv-2308-10237.description: Abstract For linear networks, where the coupling between the agents takes place through periodic impulses, a simple method is proposed for synchronization. It is shown that closing the loop by (normalized) deadbeat feedback gain produces synchronous behavior if the coupling strength μ \mu is large enough.

arxiv-2308-14619.title: Compositional Semantic Mix for Domain Adaptation in Point Cloud Segmentation
arxiv-2308-14619.creator: Cristiano Saltori, Fabio Galasso, Giuseppe Fiameni, Nicu Sebe, Fabio Poiesi, Elisa Ricci
arxiv-2308-14619.description: Abstract Deep-learning models for 3D point cloud semantic segmentation exhibit limited generalization capabilities when trained and tested on data captured with different sensors or in varying environments due to domain shift. Domain adaptation methods can be employed to mitigate this domain shift, for instance, by simulating sensor noise, developing domain-agnostic generators, or training point cloud completion networks.

arxiv-2310-17666.title: Second Born electrons, born again seamen
arxiv-2310-17666.creator: A. R. P. Rau Department of Physics and Astronomy, Louisiana State University, Baton Rouge, Louisiana 70803
arxiv-2310-17666.description: Abstract The multiple puns in the title play on a curiosity, that the rescue of a person overboard at sea and the dominance of the second Born term in forward charge transfer in atomic collisions share common elements of physics. Essentials and commonality in the two are explained.

arxiv-2312-00602.title: Victor Kac
arxiv-2312-00602.description: Abstract We give a review of the B-type Kadomtsev-Petviashvili (BKP) hierarchy, and find all polynomial tau-functions of the n n -th reduced BKP hierarchy (= n n -th Sawada-Kotera hierarchy). The name comes from the fact that for n = 3 n=3 the simplest equation of the hierarchy is the famous Sawada-Kotera equation.

arxiv-2502-05536.title: Relative Reality Thanks: ∗ Corresponding author
arxiv-2502-05536.creator: Rongwei Yang University at Albany, SUNY
arxiv-2502-05536.description: Abstract . The “Hard Problem” of consciousness refers to a long-standing enigma about how qualia emerge from physical processes in the brain. Building on insights from the development of non-Euclidean geometry, this paper seeks to present a structured and logically coherent theory of qualia to address this problem.

pmc-10498397.title: The Impact of Hospital Exposures Prior to Total Knee Arthroplasty on Postoperative Outcomes
pmc-10498397.creator: Emily M Ronan, Thomas Bieganowski, Thomas H Christensen, Joseph X Robin, Ran Schwarzkopf, Joshua C Rozell
pmc-10498397.description: BackgroundTotal knee arthroplasty (TKA) procedures are expected to grow exponentially in the upcoming years, highlighting the importance of identifying preoperative risk factors that predispose patients to poor outcomes. The present study sought to determine if preoperative healthcare events (PHEs) influenced outcomes following TKA.

pmc-10629269.title: Social system design methodology for transitioning to a new social structure – a holistic urban living lab approach to the well-being city
pmc-10629269.creator: Atsunobu Kimura, Hisashi Haraguchi, Yutaka Yamauchi, Katsuta Matsuura
pmc-10629269.description: In recent years, along with the rise of new technologies such as AI, IoT, and Bigdata, there has been much discussion replacing entire cities with smart cities. These discussions have given rise to questions about what kind of society should be realized, and keywords such as well-being and sustainability are attracting attention.

pmc-10637976.title: Spatial effects and heterogeneity analysis of the impact of environmental taxes on carbon emissions in China
pmc-10637976.creator: Pinghua Chen, Minye Rao, Lászlá Vasa, Yudan Xu, Xin Zhao
pmc-10637976.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Environmental taxes are important means by which governments can address environmental pollution problems. Amid increasingly severe global warming, how should environmental taxes be used to better combat pollution and reduce emissions to promote sustainable socioeconomic development? This empirical analysis explores the influence of environmental taxes on CO2 emissions by utilizing a spatial Durbin model constructed with panel data from 2006 to 2020 encompassing 30 provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities under the direct jurisdiction of China's central government.

pmc-10647643.title: Role of Cytokines and Other Soluble Factors in Tumor Development: Rationale for New Therapeutic Strategies
pmc-10647643.creator: Andrea Cavazzoni, Graziana Digiacomo
pmc-10647643.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). nvironment (TME); in this region, an important regulation of tumor growth is exerted by specific cytokines that can also stimulate tumor angiogenesis. Tumor and stromal cells present in the TME (tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes (TILs), cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs), cancer-associated macrophages, and endothelial cells) secrete high levels of pro-angiogenic factors that can create an abnormal vasculature, resulting in poorly perfused tumors or several inflammatory mediators, such as TNF-α, IL-6, TGF-β, and IL-10, which are involved in both the initiation and progression of cancer.

pmc-11500804.title: Controlled Ice Nucleation With a Sand-PDMS Film Device Enhances Cryopreservation of Mouse Preantral Ovarian Follicles
pmc-11500804.creator: Samantha Stewart, Alisa White, Wenquan Ou, Wei Liu, Jennifer Nagashima, Nucharin Songsasen, Xiaoming He
pmc-11500804.description: Keywords: ice-seeding; slow freezing, sand; PDMS; tissue; fertility; preservation Introduction The demand of fertility preservation for medical and personal reasons has dramatically increased in recent years [1]. Mature oocyte or embryo cryopreservation is currently the most widely explored techniques for fertility preservation [2].

pmc-11673029.title: Association Between Oxidative Potential of Particulate Matter Collected by Personal Samplers and Systemic Inflammation Among Asthmatic and Non-Asthmatic Adults
pmc-11673029.creator: Miguel Santibáñez, Juan José Ruiz-Cubillán, Andrea Expósito, Juan Agüero, Juan Luis García-Rivero, Beatriz Abascal, Carlos Antonio Amado, Laura Ruiz-Azcona, Marcos Lopez-Hoyos, Juan Irure, Yolanda Robles, Ana Berja, Esther Barreiro, Adriana Núñez-Robainas, José Manuel Cifrián, Ignacio Fernandez-Olmo
pmc-11673029.description: With the rationale that the oxidative potential of particulate matter (PM-OP) may induce oxidative stress and inflammation, we conducted the ASTHMA-FENOP study in which 44 asthmatic patients and 37 matched controls wore a personal sampler for 24 h, allowing the collection of fine and coarse PM fractions separately, to determine PM-OP by the dithiothreitol (DTT) and ascorbic acid (AA) methods.

pmc-12666819.title: Characteristics and outcomes of thromboembolism following cardiac transplant: a multi-institutional retrospective study
pmc-12666819.creator: Alexandra A Rizaldi, Michael B Streiff, Ahmet Kilic, Shruti Chaturvedi
pmc-12666819.description: BackgroundThromboembolism (TE) is a serious and potentially life-threatening complication following orthotopic heart transplant (OHT) that is not well described in current literature.ObjectivesWe aimed to characterize postoperative venous (VTE) and arterial thromboembolism (ATE) after OHT and describe their impact on survival.

pmc-13297465.title: Age-Related Differences in Neural Networks for Error Detection and Inhibitory Control: A LORETA-Based Comparative Study
pmc-13297465.creator: Kazumasa Ukai, Kazuhei Nishimoto, Hiroki Ito, Kouta Maeda, Ryosuke Yamauchi, Osamu Katayama, Shin Murata, Kiichiro Morita, Takayuki Kodama
pmc-13297465.description: Highlights What are the main findings? Older adults exhibited stronger directional connectivity from the anterior cingulate cortex (ACC) and dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (DLPFC) to the frontal polar cortex (FPC) during inhibitory tasks.Younger adults showed widespread and stronger mutual directionality between the ventral and dorsal prefrontal cortices compared to older adults. What are the implications of the main findings?

pmc-13576708.title: Can Low-Dose Radiation Therapy Aid in Chronic Subdural Hematoma Management? A Historical Review
pmc-13576708.creator: Ryan Shah, Nilanjan Haldar, Debanjan Haldar, Keenan Piper, Wenyin Shi, Pascal Jabbour
pmc-13576708.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). PurposeNeurosurgical management of chronic subdural hematoma (cSDH) is complicated by high recurrence rates, which can be especially challenging in the elderly and patients with significant comorbidities. Minimally invasive treatment with middle meningeal artery embolization is increasingly used adjunctively and as a primary treatment for those who are poor surgical candidates, but middle meningeal artery embolization carries its own risks and limitations.

pmc-13598335.title: Beyond the hashtag: a content analysis of #womenshealth posts on Instagram
pmc-13598335.creator: Brooke Nickel, Mali Dunn, Emma G Gram, Tessa Copp
pmc-13598335.description: Women increasingly rely on social media for health information, yet concerns persist about the accuracy, transparency, and commercial influence shaping this content. This content analysis of the Instagram posts using #womenshealth aimed to map women's health topics and interventions discussed and assess the presence of health claims, financial conflicts of interest, and reference to scientific evidence.
